content:
anya: Heads-up — Azure partner wants pre-approval for eu-north region quota and marketplace listing before onboarding customer pilots next month. Can we pull capacity numbers + an onboarding timeline? /cc @mike @sophia :eyes:

mike: What are the concrete quota numbers they need? vGPU slots vs instance count? we should ask for headroom (20-30%).

sophia: Partner also wants Redwood to appear in a private offer on Azure Marketplace. That triggers legal + compliance review — who owns the marketplace listing?

raj: For Dedicated pools I recommend we reserve 8x A100s for the initial pilot (est throughput ~2k tokens/s aggregated). If that sounds right I'll open an infra reservation ticket to pin capacity. Also need the exact quota payload, example below:

raj: ```
region: eu-north
requested_gpus: 8
requested_instances: 4
vCPUs_per_instance: 32
est_monthly_hours: 720
```

claire: From comms side: timeline will depend on quota approval. Rough plan: confirm capacity -> internal dry-run -> partner pilot -> joint announcement. Draft announcement copy is ready, will share once legal ok. :memo:

anya: Legal/compliance checklist: data residency statement, customer-managed KMS, audit logging, and marketplace contract terms. @sophia can you confirm if KMS integration requires extra SOW?

sophia: Confirmed: KMS integration is supported but Security wants an audit trail + config checklist. I'll loop in Security and Legal. ETA EOD Friday for a first pass.

azure-partner-bot: Partner request created: ticket AZ-4521. Partner deadline for quota: 2026-04-01. Link: https://partner.azure.com/requests/AZ-4521 (internal: escalate if we miss 2026-03-25)

mike: I'll create the Azure quota request (support case + partner portal) and add a 30% headroom. Also pinging Finance to map marketplace SKU -> billing code. @claire can you confirm which product name to use in the listing?

claire: Use "Redwood Inference (Hosted + Dedicated)" as the product title for the private offer. I'll prep a short feature bullet list and example pricing tiers.

anya: Action items recap: 1) Raj: open infra reservation ticket for 8x A100s (include cost estimate) 2) Mike: create Azure quota request + finance SKU mapping 3) Sophia: legal/compliance + security audit trail confirmation 4) Claire: marketplace listing copy + comms draft. Target: have all approvals + quota request submitted by next Tue so partner can start pilot early next month. If blockers pop up, escalate to partnerships-ops. :thumbsup:

raj: Will open infra ticket now and include the sample payload and expected monthly cost estimate. tagging @mike for SKU alignment.

mike: Thanks — I'll paste the draft support text here once created so we can iterate.

anya: thanks everyone — will follow up in this thread with tracker links.
